case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hello Ms. Aigner,

Thank you for your prompt offer and for the clear presentation. We appreciate the effort.

To be open with you, the price is not yet where we need it to be. Here is the comparison:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

We would still like to work with you, so we have put together options. They differ in payment terms, so you can choose the one that suits your business best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.13; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.69; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.03; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

Hallo, thanks for being open about the other offer. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As a small shop, cash flow is important to us, so we have to stick to the 30 days payment. But we really want to run these parts for you, so we can do DAP and drop the price to €15.70 to make it work. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our Angebot is a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Aigner,

Thank you for moving on price and for confirming that our comparison held up. We appreciate your openness, and we understand that cash flow matters to a small shop and that you still need internal approval.

To make that step easier, here are our options. Option A answers your cash flow concern with faster payment.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.76; payment 14 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 15.20; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.10; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Each option can go to your approver as it stands. We would like to work with you on this part.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We can accept your terms and await your order. Our offer is a price of €15.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Let me know if we have a deal so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

Gruß

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal and are very keen to win your business and demonstrate our capabilities as a reliable, long-term partner. For this position, our offer includes a price of €16.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. 

We look forward to the opportunity of working together and building a successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your proposal and for the warm words. We value your interest in working with us and the clear way you set out your offer.

To bring it in line with what we need for this part, we have put together three options for you to choose from. Each one has a different balance of price and payment terms, so please pick the one that suits you best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.15; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 13.74; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.10; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

We would be glad to move ahead with one of these and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate the options provided, but the requested DAP delivery and 35-day lead time require additional logistical and operational resources. 

To support your budget while ensuring reliable execution, we propose maintaining EXW terms and a 45-day lead time. Based on these terms, we are pleased to offer a revised price of EUR 15.40 per unit. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.40 per unit.

Our primary proposed terms stand at a price of €17.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. Beside this package, we can present an alternative at our standard terms offering a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW.

Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your revised proposal and for explaining what DAP delivery and the shorter lead time involve for you. We appreciate the effort.

To be open with you, the comparison looks like this:

Another supplier has offered EUR 15.70 for this part (offer:DEMO-J1-1).

With that in mind, here are our options.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.82; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.39; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.77; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

We would value working with you and hope one of these works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. To move closer to your target while maintaining the requested DAP delivery and 35-day lead time, we have reduced our price to EUR 16.60 per unit. 

Our updated Angebot now stands at a price of €16.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are committed to providing reliable execution and hope this adjustment demonstrates our willingness to build a long-term partnership.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.
